notes.title: Super Magbot Patch v1.02
notes.content:
This patch fixes some bugs mainly for the speedrun community and adds some minor features.

[list]
[*] Added -skipintro executable parameter to skip the logos/intro when starting the game.
[*] Added option in the Options/Graphics menu to enable/disable VSYNC.
[*] Fixed timestep simulation in all player movement actions. (Fixes the Dash bending bug on high fps PCs)
[*] Now you can't pause when the player character is playing Birth/Death animations. This prevents the pause softlock bug.
[*] Now all the core game actors are updated with a fixed timestep.
[*] Added Discord community button in the main menu. (Only PC version)
[*] Fixed Bubble Magnets not removing Queue Animators Actors causing bad performance.
[*] Teleport magnets travel sound stops when going back to the main menu from pause.
[*] 4-9 missing background tile fixed.
[*] 4-18 fixed connection ids for the connected swapping magnets of this level.
[*] 4-21 Camera Limits fixed. Now the camera will not move in this level.
[*] 2-16 Fixed wrong background tiles.
[*] Fixed camera reposition bug in Boss 3 (Octofok)
[/list]

notes.title: Magnet Monday
notes.content:
"Greetings, fellow robots!

This is Magnet Monday, your guide to the magnets that you'll encounter across various levels on your journey to save the galaxy in Super Magbot."

[h2]Fragile Magnets[/h2]

Do not let these Magnets get in your way! Shoot at them using the opposite colour with your magnetic ray to get propelled and smash through them - use the same colour to propulse Magbot off. It's always fun to break things, but be aware that fragile magnets won't be merged back once they are broken!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4iIXH8r.gif[/img]

[h2]Platform Magnets[/h2]

Watch your footing! Step carefully when you encounter platform magnets, even the slightest, minimal contact will collapse them down. These magnets require for you to shoot your ray, FAST. Make sure you don't meander about for too long, or you'll fall into the abyss. However, they do respawn after a few seconds -- so if you absolutely need to back track, you can. (Or just fall and perish).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZR8KmyI.gif[/img]

[h2]Jumper Magnets[/h2]

These dual-layered Magnets can be used to make impressive jumps! This is where I really begin to turn heads and dazzle spectators! If you are brave enough, shoot at them using the same color to perform a big, long jump across the level. Use the opposite color to perform a short one, in case you are afraid of heights. Please, check the roof before jumping...  

Here I am, performing at my best. What's new? Just a regular day at the office. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LcaUSxh.gif[/img]

[h2]Bubble Magnets[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YCedEpt.gif[/img]

You'll exclusively encounter bubble magnets in places with sub-zero temperatures, like Mag Zero - brrr; it's freezing over there! Bubble magnets function as if they were air bubbles, they float in the air and plateau, waiting for Super Magbot. Use the opposite colour to enter the magnet - once inside the Magnet, use the opposite colour to get propulsed forward; or use the same colour if you want to get propulsed backwards.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ooIgcop.gif[/img] 

[h2]Cloud Magnets[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/isWQ8pD.gif[/img]  

Occasionally, when the temperatures are at scorching heights, the Magnetic dust from the air can merge into a Cloud Magnet! As this Magnet is made of dust, you can't collide against it. Use the same colour to get propulsed off - and use the opposite colour to get attracted through the cloud magnet. Try to shoot just after reaching the cloud to perform two jumps in a row!  

Sounds easy, right? Well, maybe for me - but I'm unsure whether you're up to the challenge..... I guess you'll have to prove me wrong. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XOcHWgg.gif[/img]

notes.title: Super Magbot is OUT NOW! | Master the power of magnets!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello! I'm Super Magbot!😁[/h3]

Today, I am delighted to announce the launch of ME, Super Magbot! Good luck out there in the field, you'll need it :) Hehe! Are you Magbot enough? Above all, make sure you ENJOY it! Have fun, magnets are a wild time. 🧲

The magnetic puzzle-platformer, Super Magbot, is now available on Steam! The debut title from Astral Pixel, Super Magbot sees players guide the robotic Magbot as he tries to save his home planet of MagTek from the peril tearing through the planetary system of Magnetia. Although incapable of jumping, Magbot is armed with powerful magnetic abilities that help him traverse the many traps, platforms, and enemies he’ll encounter throughout the galaxy.

[h3]Check out the attractive launch trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=p4uWRGWyj_8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Key features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Harness magnetic power: [/b]Answer MagTek’s call for help, and use the power of magnets to traverse through dozens of puzzle-filled levels brought to life in colourful 16-bit retro visuals
[*] [b]Unlock secrets:[/b] Find Star Fragments throughout the gameworld that hide further secrets along the way and add an extra layer of difficulty to Magbot’s adventure
[*] [b]Attract or repel competitors:[/b] Global leaderboards showcase each level’s best times as players rise to the challenge to save the Magnetia system
[*] [b]Assist Modes:[/b] Swap the frantic action for a relaxed puzzle experience with a mix of infinite colour charges, endless air time and mid-level checkpoints
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ezdQuuA.gif[/img]

[h3]NO JUMPING![/h3]

Poles apart from any other games in the field, Super Magbot sees players control the character of Magbot, an endearing robot who uses blue and red magnetic beams to attract and repel themselves across the platforms, perils, and pitfalls of the game world!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/699ejDF.gif[/img]

[h3]Can you tell me more?
[/h3]
Sure! The system of Magnetia is in great peril as an evil villain tears through the galaxy. It’s all down to one robot explorer to save the day – Magbot!

Armed with the power to control both positive and negative magnetic polarities, Magbot must navigate through a myriad of challenging platforming environments to save his home planet of Mag Tek.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37459635/3209e92ff12db057f98acf1709ffa1b4f1ddcb62.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZNVeScd.png[/img]

[h3]PRICING[/h3]

The standard edition of Super Magbot is available with a 20% discount until 5th July 2021 on Steam (Discount price of $14.39/€14.39/£11.59 versus a SRP of $17.99/€17.99/£14.49) with a deluxe version on Steam subject to a further 15% bundle discount that includes the game and both digital soundtracks (Discount price of $19.02/€19.02/£15.79 versus SRP of $22.07/€22.07/£18.25.)

The sun is shining, Magbot is beaming -- because this week I'm showing off TWO new magnets! TWO! Fantastic news for everyone involved, we're all happy to be here. 

Let's kick things off!

[h3]Swapping Colour Magnets[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ezdQuuA.gif[/img]

As the Tekians can only use one colour, the first Tekian engineers created these Magnets. This way, every Tekian could make use of any Magnet. Swapping Colour magnets switch to the opposite colour as soon as you shoot them. The colour swapping is basically instantaneous, so perhaps you can take advantage of it in some way! 

[h3]Who are the Tekians?[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mmmBgfx.gif[/img]

The Tekians are the inhabitants of MagTeK. They are all robots and each one of them can manipulate one magnetic polarity (either blue or red). They are intelligent, peaceful robots who enjoy socialising and being active. Visually, they are red or blue - depending on the polarity colour they can manage. 🧲

[h3]Gum Magnets[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iTwFHce.gif[/img]

Only the most advanced explorers know about the existence of these bouncy Magnets. So get good! Shoot at them using the same colour to get propulsed off. Use the opposite colour to attract to them and bounce off in the reflected direction. Changing your shooting angle with superb precision will make you bounce further! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uhymkdo.gif[/img]

notes.title: Super Magbot's Magnets
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LmOlCu7.gif[/img]
[h3]Hey, everyone![/h3]
You may be perplexed as to how you can navigate levels without the ability to jump on Magtek, that's absolutely fine! Magbots are very, very heavy -- meaning they cannot jump! Luckily, Super Magbot is armed with a magnetic weapon ray, which comes in handy because Magteck is permeated with a variety of up to eight magnets throughout the game! 
	
As with most platformers, using a gamepad will provide you the best possible experience - but using your keyboard and mouse is fine, too! 
	
The image below illustrates how you will use the bumpers on your controller to work with the magnets throughout Magtek, as you guide Magbot through the levels and challenges you'll face. (A - D. Left/Right Click -- mouse & keyboard)
	
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g7IRvyi.gif[/img]
[b]Press the bumpers to use Magnbot's magnetic weapon ray[/b]
	
Levels are filled with Red (Positive) and Blue (Negative) magnets - and Magbot has to shoot Red or Blue magnetic rays against them to jump. Shooting a ray with the same colour as the magnet creates a Repulsion movement. Shooting a ray with the opposite colour as the magnet creates an Attraction movement. These magnets allow Magbot to [strike]jump[/strike] and move fast through the levels. 
	
Magnets can be identified by their shape and colour. Most magnets deactivate when they are hit by Magbot’s magnetic ray and after some time, they reactivate themselves to be used again. This is useful to prevent Magbot from spamming any magnet (avoid double jumps...). 
	
	
[h3]Simple Magnet[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hjjCkHr.png[/img]
[b]The simple magnet acts as a blocking surface and depending on the colour:[/b]
	
[b]Red simple magnet - [/b]Generates attraction when hit by a blue magnetic ray. Generates repulsion when hit by a red magnetic ray. 
	
[b]Blue simple magnet -[/b] Generates repulsion when hit by a blue magnetic ray. Generates attraction when hit by a red magnetic ray. 
	
[img]https://i.imgur.com/o2jYCby.gif[/img]
[b]Use the power of magnetic attraction to pull yourself towards platforms and across perilous pitfalls[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kMsif97.gif[/img]
[b]Use the power of magnetic repulsion to boost you through the air[/b]
	
[h3]Fragile Magnet [/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SwydQqH.png[/img]
[b]Fragile magnets destroy themselves upon impact[/b]

Like the Simple magnet; but when hit, instead of deactivating/reactivating, the fragile magnet destroys itself. This can be used to let Magbot go through them. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rAILEkZ.gif[/img]
[b]Magbot can use the fragile magnets as a boost mechanism 	[/b]



This is just a small chunk of the magnets you'll use to navigate Super Magbot's challenging plethora of levels!

We'll share more on the rest of Magtek's magnets in good time! Hopefully this little guide helps you gauge an improved understanding of how navigation works on Magtek!
	
	
Thanks for reading, see you soon!

notes.title: Introducing Super Magbot!

We're excited to announce that Team17 has partnered with with Catalan Developers, Astral Pixel to bring 2D platformer Super Magbot to Steam next year!

Check out the positively charged trailer:

[previewyoutube=jGsMfEYGWjo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What is Super Magbot?[/h1]

Super Magbot is a challenging 2D platformer where you can’t jump! You must utilise your magnetic powers to quickly and precisely beat each level and save the galaxy from a terrible fate.

The system of Magnetia is in great peril as an evil villain tears through the galaxy. It’s all down to one robot explorer to save the day – Super Magbot!

Armed with the power to control both positive and negative magnetic polarities, Super Magbot must navigate through a myriad of hardcore platforming environments and save his home planet of Mag Tek.
[list]
[*][b]Use Magnetic Force to Attract: Use the power of magnetic attraction to pull yourself towards platforms and across perilous pitfalls.[/b]
[/list]
[url=https://imgur.com/DlIXMpB][img]https://i.imgur.com/DlIXMpB.gif[/img][/url]
[list]
[*][b]Use Magnetic Force to Repel: Magbots are very heavy and can’t jump! Use the power of magnetic repulsion to boost you through the air![/b]
[/list]
[url=https://imgur.com/3AmKq2s][img]https://i.imgur.com/3AmKq2s.gif[/img][/url]

Harness the power of magnetism to traverse and overcome over 100 unique and brutally puzzling levels!

Super Magbot releases 2021 on Steam for PC.

Keep up to speed with all things Super Magbot and support us ahead of launch by adding us to your Wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205170/Super_Magbot/
(Thank you!!)
